# MazAPI - Enterprise API & AI Security Intelligence Platform

> Comprehensive, zero-egress, multi-tier API and AI security platform unifying pre-production static AST code discovery, AI Agent & MCP supply-chain audits, active OWASP API Top 10 DAST testing, calibrated ML threat detection, and an in-browser Side Panel interactive workbench.

## Project Overview
- **Name:** MazAPI Security Platform
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Mazonia/api-security
- **License:** MIT
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+, Docker, Manifest V3 (Chrome/Brave), VS Code Extension
- **Compliance:** OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023), CycloneDX 1.6 AI-BOM, PCI-DSS v4.0, GDPR, ISO/IEC 27001

## Core Architecture & Engines

### 1. App Surface Discovery Engine (PR-Time Static Analysis)
- Native AST syntax tree parsers across 7 ecosystems: Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django), Node.js (Express/Nest/Fastify), Embedded C/C++ IoT (ESP-IDF/Arduino/FreeRTOS), Java (Spring Boot), .NET (ASP.NET Core), Go (Gin/Echo/Fiber), and PHP (Laravel/Symfony).
- Shadow API Git Diffing: Compares `--base` vs `--head` commits to isolate undocumented routes before deployment.
- Specification Synthesis: Automatically generates OpenAPI 3.0 and AsyncAPI 3.0 specs and exports findings to GitHub SARIF.

### 2. AI Agent Audit Engine (AI Supply-Chain & Actuation Guardrails)
- Analyzes 11+ agentic frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, Haystack, DSPy, OpenAI Swarm, and AWS Bedrock Agents.
- Flags cyber-physical actuator triggers executing without Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization.
- Detects confused deputy sinks, excessive agency (unbounded OS shells, financial mutation), and unconstrained multi-tenant RAG queries.
- Generates CycloneDX 1.6 AI-BOM tracking models, parameters, data flows, and tool sinks.

### 3. Model Context Protocol (MCP) & IoT Security Auditor
- Audits custom MCP server source code and inspects against a database of 50+ vetted MCP servers.
- Evaluates IoT protocol endpoints (MQTT broker ACLs, CoAP UDP reflection, and insecure OTA surfaces).

### 4. Machine Learning Threat Detector & BOLT Workbench
- Calibrated 32-feature Random Forest model with 99.73% validation accuracy for anomaly and OWASP threat detection.
- Persistent Chrome/Brave Side Panel workbench (Manifest V3) for live traffic harvesting, JWT inspection, and BOLA/IDOR parameter tampering.

## Quickstart & CLI Reference

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Mazonia/api-security.git
cd api-security

# Launch complete local testing lab (Docker)
cd api-security-project
docker compose up -d --build

# Run AST route discovery
mazapi app-surface scan ./vulnerable-api --format table

# Audit AI Agent workspace and export AI-BOM
mazapi agent-audit scan ./agent_audit --governance --format ai-bom -o ./ai-bom.json

# Run active OWASP DAST vulnerability scan
mazapi scan --target http://localhost:8000 --format sarif -o ./scan-results.sarif
```
